method: Recompiled the test main and linked against existing candidate libraries. The ordinary file probe ran with and without an externally mapped valid font. A separate test-only entry called the same exerciseDirectWriteFile function with an already mapped seven-byte destination to check the first overwrite deterministically. The mapping process closed its reader handle and kept the view until after the probe exited.
result: Both mapped controls in both configurations reported the expected stage and Win32 error 1224, and listed the known external PID. Both ordinary runs without a held mapping exited zero after 1000 cycles. No historical failure is reclassified.
